abilities.name: All or Nothing
abilities.description: Once per encounter, before your partner Digimon makes an attack roll, you may declare All or Nothing. That attack takes a -5 penalty to its hit roll. If it still hits, double the damage dice rolled for that attack (a Critical Hit combines with this doubling for 4x total damage). If it misses, your partner Digimon cannot make any attacks next round.

abilities.name: Calculated Risk
abilities.description: All or Nothing's penalty decreases from -5 to -2.

abilities.name: Push Your Luck
abilities.description: All or Nothing can be used once per round instead of once per encounter.

abilities.name: Guaranteed Opener
abilities.description: The first attack your partner Digimon makes each encounter automatically hits, no hit roll required. You may not apply any modifications to this attack in any way, or use this hit with any other abilities.

abilities.name: History Repeats
abilities.description: Whenever you use All or Nothing, your partner Digimon's next attack automatically resolves the same way this one did: hit follows hit, miss follows miss, Critical Hit follows Critical Hit, no roll needed. Any modifiers and bonuses that applied to the first attack apply again to this second attack as well. If All or Nothing missed and locked your partner Digimon out of attacking next round, this effect instead applies to the first attack they make once that lockout ends.

abilities.name: Not Today
abilities.description: Once between rests, when your partner Digimon reaches 0 HP, you may keep them in the fight instead, restoring their HP by up to 2x their highest Crest Stat rank. They do not dedigivolve, and no other effects from reaching 0 HP trigger, other than this one. If the hit that reduced your partner Digimon to 0 HP would have taken them into negative HP, this ability still restores HP as though they'd stopped exactly at 0; the overflow damage doesn't eat into how much you restore.
